$schema.description: Optional. Where the JSON Schema for this file is, so editors can check it as you type.

name.description: What the person will recognize the flow by.

request.description: What the person asked for, in their words.

id.description: Short id that steps use to refer to this agent, e.g. "writer".

provider.description: Only "anthropic" runs for real today; others run in simulated mode.

tools.description: What this agent uses unless a step says otherwise. Tool ids, e.g. ["files"]. Only "files" (read and write in workspace/) is connected for real runs today.

agent.description: The id of the agent that does this step.

task.description: A short name for the card, e.g. "Draft pricing page".

prompt.description: What the agent is told to do, in plain language: what to make, from what, where to save it. Earlier steps’ results are passed along automatically.

stage.description: Steps in the same stage run at the same time. Stage 1 starts when all of stage 0 is done. Count up from 0 without gaps.

tools.description: Replaces the agent’s tools for this step. Tool ids, e.g. ["files"]. Only "files" (read and write in workspace/) is connected for real runs today.

approval.description: "always": ask the person before acting. "earned": ask until they’ve approved 3 times in a row, then ask less. "never": for steps that only read or write drafts.

asks.description: How the request reads after the agent’s name, e.g. "wants to publish the page". Only for steps that ask.
